slice: P2 source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE group-176 textAlignmentType
scope: One runtime-authored AC1027 DXF source with a root-reachable STANDARD MLEADERSTYLE record. It contains one group-176 INTEGER textAlignmentType value 0 and groups 174/175/178 set to 0. The selected transaction changes only textAlignmentType from 0 to 2; all other encoded style values remain unchanged.

fieldEvidence.fieldRoleSource: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference, MLEADERSTYLE group-code table identifies code 176 as Text Alignment Type
fieldEvidence.valueDomainSource: Autodesk AutoCAD 2008 ActiveX API history lists AcTextAlignmentType values: left=0, center=1, right=2
fieldEvidence.classification: Authoritative Autodesk DXF field-role and enum-domain corroboration plus authored adapter transaction evidence; not independent producer or native annotation acceptance

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The selected record must be reachable through the validated ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary, have one source-matched raw body and immutable source baseline, and contain exactly one existing group-176 INTEGER corresponding to parsed textAlignmentType. The target value must be in the documented enum range 0..2. textAlignmentType must be the only changed typed payload field; identity, common fields, handles, application data, extension data and all other encoded style fields must match the source.
contract.projection: Replace only the existing physical group-176 value in a copy of the captured raw body. Preserve all other ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing/repeated group 176, conflicting raw changes, simultaneous edits, values outside 0..2, unknown subclass grammar and non-AC1027 routes remain outside this transaction.
contract.outputAndReadback: Inspect staged OBJECTS output against retained raw fields and mapped handles, then decode the emitted MLEADERSTYLE and require textAlignmentType to equal 2 while textAngleType remains 0. Fresh readback checks the typed value and exactly one literal group-176 INTEGER value 2. Both source encodings are exercised, with same-format output and ASCII/binary cross-format output.
contract.failureAndRetry: Changing captured raw group 176 from 0 to 1 while typed textAlignmentType requests 2 refuses and preserves a sentinel destination. Value 3 also refuses atomically. Restoring the original raw body and requesting valid value 2 permits same-adapter retry. Exact output and fresh-readback checks pass after retry.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE records keep existing raw replay. Transactions are not admitted for other source or target versions or multiple changes on one record. DWG-origin writing is unchanged. Test sources and outputs are authored at runtime in a temporary directory and removed; no drawing fixture is committed.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp emits groups 174=0, 175=0, 176=0 and 178=0 in the STANDARD source; ASCII and binary source files are generated locally from scratch at test runtime.
